semantic_findings.title: Write-Capable Community Commands in Read-Only Skill
semantic_findings.description: The skill presents a read-only public workflow, but the topic reference lists create and create-reply commands for publishing community content. An agent could perform unintended social posting without explicit confirmation guidance.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The reference explicitly includes publish and reply commands, while the skill metadata and auth section present a read-only public workflow. I did not find instructions requiring confirmation before write actions.

content.value_statement: Investors and analysts need fast context from scattered Longbridge content. This skill turns news, filings, community topics, and rules into sourced summaries.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes latest Longbridge news for listed stocks.
Lists company filings and explains SEC filing types.
Summarizes community discussion volume and sentiment at a coarse level.
Answers common A-share, Hong Kong, and US market rule questions.
limitations: It depends on Longbridge CLI or MCP availability for live data.
It does not place trades or provide personalized investment advice.
Community sentiment is summarized broadly and should not be treated as market consensus.
Some regulatory references may need confirmation against current official sources.

use_cases.title: Track Stock Catalysts
use_cases.description: Review recent Longbridge news, filings, and community topics before researching a position.

use_cases.title: Review SEC Filings
use_cases.description: Extract risk, MD&A, governance, and Form 4 signals from recent SEC disclosures.

use_cases.title: Explain Market Rules
use_cases.description: Answer questions about price limits, settlement, short selling, circuit breakers, and margin rules.

prompt_templates.title: Get a Stock Digest
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize recent Longbridge news, filings, and community topics for NVDA.US. Keep it factual and include the disclaimer.

prompt_templates.title: Find Recent Filings
prompt_templates.prompt: Show recent filings for AAPL.US from Longbridge. Explain each filing type in one sentence.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze SEC Risk Signals
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the latest 10-K or 10-Q for MSFT.US. Focus on risk factors, MD&A changes, and non-recurring items.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Content Signals
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Longbridge-based view for TSLA.US using news, filings, and community topics. Separate facts, sentiment, and unresolved questions.

output_examples.input: Summarize recent Longbridge content for NVDA.US.
output: A concise digest grouped by earnings, strategic news, regulatory items, filings, and community discussion.
A neutral key takeaway and source note.

output_examples.input: Analyze the latest 10-Q for a US stock.
output: A filing metadata summary, key financial changes, MD&A highlights, risk factor updates, and an investment signal label.
Clear caveats when filing detail is sparse.

output_examples.input: Explain Hong Kong stock settlement rules.
output_examples.output: A direct rule explanation with settlement timing, practical effects, and a note to verify current rules with official sources.

best_practices: Use official tickers with market suffixes when possible.
Ask for a specific filing type when the filing question is narrow.
Separate verified Longbridge data from any fallback web search.
anti_patterns: Do not treat community discussion as confirmed facts.
Do not request trade execution or personalized investment advice.
Do not ask the skill to publish community posts without explicit review.

faq.question: Does this skill require login?
faq.answer: Read-only Longbridge content is described as public, but some CLI commands may require local setup or authentication.

faq.question: Can it analyze SEC filings?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports narrative analysis for 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statements, and Form 4 filings.

faq.question: Does it give investment advice?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes information and includes a disclaimer. Users should make their own decisions.

faq.question: What data source does it prefer?
faq.answer: It prefers Longbridge data and clearly labels any fallback web search.

faq.question: Can it summarize community sentiment?
faq.answer: Yes. It reports broad sentiment and avoids quoting individual comments verbatim.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
